group_assessment.weighting: A clinical-genomics WGS programme. Credible on SV and splice detection; for WWOX it reports DNA-level validation only and points to an earlier case series for the patient.

field_density.note: LEGEND holds no record of this paper; it holds Piard 2019 (PMID 30356099) as PAPER 117, whose Patient 11 this paper re-reports.

resolved.how: Piard 2019 is held with receipted readings in LEGEND; its Supplementary Table 1 (files/fulltext/PMID30356099_Piard2019_supplement/41436_2018_339_MOESM1_ESM.xlsx) was opened here and read cell-wise: Patient 11 is c.[517_1056del];[705dupG], the same genotype.

entries.proposition: The WWOX allele pair is an in-frame 219 kb deletion of exons 6-8 in trans with c.705dup p.(His236fs); the 180-amino-acid loss 'including the mitochondrial targeting sequence' is stated from coordinates, with no RNA or protein assay reported.
entries.snippet: A fifth SV led to an in-frame 219 kb deletion of exons 6–8 of WWOX, leading to loss of 180 amino acids including the mitochondrial targeting sequence.
entries.anchor: Results, Structural variants, fifth SV paragraph

entries.proposition: The paper itself states that this compound heterozygous genotype was previously reported in a published case series (ref 97 = Piard 2019), so the patient is not an independent observation.
entries.snippet: These compound heterozygous variants were previously reported as part of a case series expanding the phenotypic spectrum associated with this gene [97].
entries.anchor: Results, Structural variants, fifth SV paragraph

entries.proposition: Table 1 (published as an image) names the case as Patient 11 of Piard 2019 Table S1, gives validation as PCR and Sanger sequencing (DNA only), consequence 'Inframe deletion', and the reason it was missed as the gene not being on the validated panel, with the deletion 'detectable by array'.
entries.snippet: Reported as Patient 11 (Table S1) in case series in Piard et al [97].
entries.anchor: Table 1, row 009Sev001 (13073_2023_1240_Tab1_HTML.jpg, 540x1651, rotated 90 degrees and cropped to the row; read at 150%)
entries.qualifies_needle: previously reported as part of a case series

entries.proposition: Table S7 lists the frameshift with zygosity 'hom' and the deletion 'het' in a case with one sequenced sample: the frameshift lies inside the deleted interval and is called hemizygous, which is what places the two alleles in trans; no parental genotypes are listed.
entries.snippet: D=WWOX | E=chr16:g.78424965_78424966insG | F=ENST00000566780.5:p.His236fs | G=frameshift_variant | H=CH | I=hom

entries.proposition: Table S7 applies PVS1 (a null-variant criterion) to the in-frame deletion as well as to the frameshift; the deletion's consequence is annotated, not measured.

entries.proposition: The row-level reason the WWOX case was missed before WGS is the panel's gene content, not an array failure.
entries.snippet: Q=Gene not incorporated into validated panel test at the time of referral

entries.proposition: The paper's general statement groups the WWOX deletion with three other SVs said to be missable by arrays for probe coverage, thresholds or gene novelty; it is not specific to WWOX.
entries.snippet: Although in principle, four of these SVs (WWOX, two FOXD3 and DHRS3 variants) could have been detected by arrays, they were not picked up by standard of care testing prior to WGS referral
